playstyle: Six Chaos beastmen—two durable 4-health brutes backed by four fragile 2-health minions—all share Move 4, spreading swiftly and evenly across the board. The warband runs one of two Chaos warscrolls: a territory-control build Inspires fighters that outnumber enemies in neutral zones and Staggers foes through Delving, while a kill-reward build chains Inspirations and combat buffs with every melee slay. Victory comes from driving the resilient frontliners—especially the hard-hitting Draknar—into priority targets while the minion screen contests ground and chips with ranged attacks.
